mapper.sql: id, run_id, item_key, item_kind, status, document_id, retry_count, next_attempt_at, error_code, error_summary, checkpoint::text AS checkpoint, checkpoint_attempt, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO ingest_run_item (run_id, item_key, item_kind) SELECT #{runId}, #{itemKey}, 'URL' WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ingest_run WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' ) ON CONFLICT (run_id, item_key) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now() RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE ingest_run_item SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, error_code = 'HTTP_429', error_summary = 'Remote source requested a deferred retry', updated_at = now() WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE ingest_run_item item SET status = #{status}, document_id = #{documentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, checkpoint = CAST(#{checkpointJson} AS jsonb), checkpoint_attempt = #{attempt}, error_code = NULL, error_summary = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE item.id = #{itemId} AND item.run_id = #{runId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ingest_run run WHERE run.id = #{runId} AND run.status = 'RUNNING' AND run.attempt = #{attempt} AND run.lease_token = CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid) )
